reason: This PR is mainly a slow-log configurability feature: new global/session variables and executor/sessionctx plumbing for dynamic trigger rules, including ConnID-specific logging. Despite touching `executor` and `sessionctx`, the apparent blast radius is observability/logging behavior rather than planner semantics, executor correctness, transaction/session protocol correctness, privilege enforcement, statistics, KV consistency, or parser SQL semantics. It does not look central or risky enough to justify a 20-40 minute deep review aimed at Blocker/High issues in those core areas.
